plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Personal orchestrator for Claude Code: tracks a repo's Initiative through an agent-assisted engineering methodology, phase by phase.

plugins.name: skillartisan
plugins.description: Build, validate, secure, and maintain Claude Skills. Supersedes Anthropic's shipped skill-creator with a spec-compliant, cross-vendor, security-hardened successor: frontmatter validation, a combined decision/dedup gate, a five-surface compatibility matrix, gitleaks-based security scanning with tamper detection, the full with/without-skill evaluation engine, lifecycle classification, and an audit mode for upgrading, rebuilding, and bulk-auditing existing skills.

plugins.name: solid-coding
plugins.description: Language-agnostic methodology for writing and refactoring code against SOLID, GoF design patterns, and complementary principles (DRY, KISS, YAGNI, Boy Scout, SoC, Encapsulation, Law of Demeter, CQS, TDD, AHA) — for whole-worktree refactors and live in-flight review alike. Wires into whatever CI/QA a repo already has and verifies every finding through an adversarial reviewer/verifier subagent pair before touching code.

plugins.name: simplicity
plugins.description: Session ergonomics for Claude Code: /simplicity:just-ask collects every open question in the session and asks them through AskUserQuestion with a recommended option and reasoning; /simplicity:just-say-it re-states the latest response(s) as a short plain-language numbered list; /simplicity:what-now takes stock of the session and lists what's done, where the current task stands and the next steps; /simplicity:just-finish-it pushes the session's branches, opens missing PRs, waits for CI and merges the ones that pass, through gh or the GitHub MCP server; /simplicity:cleanup runs an end-of-session checklist that stops background work and flags uncommitted or unpushed changes; /simplicity:rename-session renames the session after what it was actually about; /simplicity:promptfy rewrites a prompt into a stronger one and hands it back without running it. Every skill except just-finish-it also runs when named mid-sentence.

plugins.name: agent-router
plugins.description: Sizes subagents to the task. Four pre-sized agent tiers (scout, worker, analyst, judge) with pinned model and effort; a routing skill; an enforcement hook that rejects mismatched spawns with one line naming the correct call; a per-project spawn log with outcome signals; and /agent-router:report, which proposes tier changes from that log for a person to accept or reject. Optional vendor mode covers cloud sessions. Hooks make no model or network calls.
